fact: The tabled 2026 finance bill (proposed, not yet enacted) names FCFA 874,046,000 for programme 380 Modernisation du cadastre (national digital cadastre) under the Ministry of State Property, Surveys and Land Tenure, financed from domestic revenue.

The 2025 finance law appropriates FCFA 1,567,500,000 for programme 026 Modernisation du cadastre (national digital cadastre) under the Ministry of State Property, Surveys and Land Tenure, financed from domestic revenue; the bill figure is the same.

The 2024 finance law appropriated XAF 1,203,574,000 (FCFA, stated domestic revenue) to programme 026 Modernisation du cadastre, chapitre 37 (Ministry of Domains, Cadastre and Land Affairs), whose stated objective is a national digital cadastre; the same amount was proposed on 2023-11-30.
